questions.question: 1. How does viewing a rendered project in virtual reality differ from viewing a high-quality render on a desktop or laptop computer?

answers.a: It provides depth perception and a sense of scale, making you feel like you are inside the space
answers.b: It displays higher resolution images than any desktop monitor
answers.d: It eliminates the need for client presentations

explanations.a: VR allows users to experience space, scale, and emotion in ways that flat screens cannot replicate.

questions.question: 2. Does virtual reality allow for space exploration?

answers.a: Yes, with tethered HMDs and sufficient computing power, you can navigate virtual spaces
answers.b: No, VR is limited to desktop viewing only
answers.d: Yes, but only for outer space, not interior environments

explanations.a: VR can create immersive, navigable environments, though high-quality experiences require powerful systems.

answers.b: It is fully compatible with any PC or mobile device
answers.c: High processing power is needed, and software is often in early development stages
answers.d: It eliminates the need for real-world measurements

explanations.c: VR is still developing, and high-quality immersive experiences require advanced hardware and software.

questions.question: 4. Augmented reality (AR) and virtual reality (VR) are the same?

explanations.b: AR overlays digital elements onto the real world, while VR immerses the user in a fully virtual environment.

questions.question: 5. How will we interact with technology in the future?

explanations.d: Future technology aims for brain–computer interfaces, enabling control of devices through thoughts instead of physical inputs.

questions.question: 6. Which logic gate gives HIGH output when at least one input is HIGH?

explanations.b: An OR gate outputs HIGH if any one or more inputs are HIGH

questions.question: 7. What is the output of an AND gate when both inputs are HIGH (1)?

explanations.b: An AND gate produces HIGH output only when all its inputs are HIGH.

questions.question: 8. Which logic gate is known as an inverter?

explanations.d: A NOT gate inverts the input signal, changing HIGH to LOW and LOW to HIGH.
